title: ロボット応用力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Dynamics of Machine Systems I
keywords: Force and moment of force 2.Equation of motion 3.Center of gravity and moment of inerti 4.Vibration and damping 5.Lagrange equation
educationalGoal: (1) Understand and derive the equations of motion of mass points, mass point systems, and rigid bodies. (2) Solve and evaluate equations of motion. (3) Acquire the mathematical knowledge necessary for applying equations of motion.
advice: Mechanics is the basis for all subjects in this course. In particular, vibration may cause many problems in mechanical systems. Students are required to learn the equations of motion and linear differential equations to understand vibration. Students are expected to derive Newton's equation based on force vectors and apply Lagrange's equation to a variety of mechanical problems.
requiredKnowledge: Review Robot Basic Mechanics I & II and mathematics such as trigonometric functions and differential equations.

activityGoals.body: Understand the motion of mass points under external forces such as restoring force and damping force.
Calculate the center of gravity and moment of inertia of a simple shape object.
Understand the relationship between angular momentum and moment of force.
Understand and apply the laws of conservation of mechanical energy, momentum and angular momentum.
Describe the equation of motion of a mass system and rigid body using Lagrange's equation.

lessons.content: Motion of point mass Viscous damping force and viscous resistance force
Restoring force and vibration Harmonic motion
Circular motion and phase Momentum conservation law
Kinetic energy Potential energy and concervative force
Force field Mechanical energy conservation law
Freedom of motion and constraints Dissipation function
Center of gravity and moment of inertia Angular momentum
Moment of force Angular momentum conservation law
Equation of rigid body motion Kinematic energy of rotating system
Rigid body motion with fixed axis Physical pendulum
Rigid body motion in plane motion Application of Lagrangian
